submitted.rationale: Index 20 (Sb 0.88) gave the highest measured EQE, 0.00198%. Its neighbours were lower: index 17 (0.83) gave 0.00143% and index 25 (0.93) gave 0.00113%. This suggests a local peak near Sb≈0.88. All EQE values on this line are very small under 2.4 eV light, which fits wide-gap Zn–Sb oxides. XRD at indices 15 and 20 showed the same dominant peak at Q≈2.79 Å⁻¹. None of the database phases I tested matched well (all similarity scores ≤0.25).
